description: the napi-field-access-enhanced pass promoted into the canonical recursive file: enhanced extraction adds decimal-offset matching, param_1 alias tracking, and pure vtable-trampoline slot detection on top of the callee-targets pass's depth-1 callee chase. See manifests/napi_field_access_enhanced.json for the same data plus newly-recovered diff metadata. The event-condition-tracing-and-rigorous-negatives pass merged the virtual-dispatch-queries pass vtable-resolved evidence into deepReads / deepWrites / deepNestedReads, expanding coverage of the trampoline impls' actual field-access. New per-entry field `vtableViaClasses` records which Class-override contributed each merged read/write.

corpusExtension.method: the bridge-growth-and-ceiling pass: extended N-API corpus with AreaBase (9 APIs), PrivateAreaBase (1 API), GroupBase (16 APIs - BCS-Y-0228 prose undercounted by 6). LAB_-style impl entries auto-created via DumpFunctionDecompAutoCreate.java. Direct-only field-access extraction (no callee chase) since these classes lack callee_targets entries.

itemBaseCorpusExtension.method: the bridge-growth-and-ceiling pass: extended the N-API corpus with ItemBase. Switchboard FUN_00753DD0 walked by WalkWrappersForLuaCallbacks.java; firers decompiled by DumpFunctionDecomp.java; impl entries decompiled with DumpFunctionDecompAutoCreate.java because most targets were LAB-style entries. Direct-only field-access extraction is used for deepReads/deepWrites, matching the bridge-growth-and-ceiling pass. Item-record reads reached after FUN_006ee480/FUN_006ee3e0 handle resolution are recorded in resolvedItemReads/resolvedItemNestedReads and are not promoted to ItemBase direct offsets.

actorBaseCorpusExtension.method: the bridge-growth-and-ceiling pass: extended the N-API corpus with ActorBase. Switchboard FUN_00753C30 walked by WalkWrappersForLuaCallbacks.java; firers decompiled by DumpFunctionDecomp.java; impl entries decompiled with DumpFunctionDecompAutoCreate.java. Direct-only field-access extraction is used for deepReads/deepWrites, matching Phases 23e and 23f. ActorBase is the primary parent of CharaBase, so bridge passes can evaluate ActorBase readers against descendant actor receiver writes via the hierarchy rules.
